breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet (u=0 on all edges) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundary conditions and only specifies the Dirichlet condition: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions, setting u=0 on all four boundaries of the domain.' This successfully resolves the inconsistency.
